item.title: Adelaide Fringe’s Immersive Worlds program invites audiences inside 23 amazing interactive experiences
item.description: Adelaide Fringe’s Immersive Worlds features 23 VR, 360° film and interactive experiences across Adelaide and regional SA, transforming how audiences experience live art.

item.title: Sanctuary returns to Adelaide riverbank with global DJs and immersive industrial art
item.description: Adelaide’s favourite pop-up summer dance destination, Sanctuary, is back with a bang, promising a series of jam-packed Saturday nights and one epic Friday night party.

item.title: Cafe, vintage store & gift shop unite under one roof at refreshed Grounded Lonsdale
item.description: Grounded Lonsdale’s popular café, gift shop and vintage store has entered a new chapter under fresh ownership, with plans for co-working, workshops and community-focused experiences shaping its future.

item.title: Planning approval secured for Mount Barker’s new hotel and leisure hub
item.description: Planning approval has been secured for a new Mount Barker hotel and family entertainment precinct, bringing accommodation, attractions and a refreshed tavern to the Adelaide Hills.

item.title: Heritage-listed Kent Town landmark reborn as dual apartment towers bringing 211 new homes
item.description: After more than a decade sitting empty, a Kent Town landmark is set for new life, with plans for two apartment towers, 211 homes and restoration of a heritage-listed site.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Thursday February 19th and the days ahead
item.description: With a cool couple of days, Thursday has you easing towards the weekend. Here's your Adelaide forecast for today and the days ahead.

item.title: Dyslexia support expands to every government school in South Australia
item.description: South Australian government schools will receive expanded teacher training, reading resources and early intervention tools to support students with dyslexia from 2026.

item.title: Australian Beach Volleyball Tour kicks off at Glenelg this weekend
item.description: The Australian Beach Volleyball Tour kicks off at Glenelg this weekend, with 112 teams and top Australian players competing in the opening round of the 2026 season.

item.title: MotoGP heads to Adelaide in 2027 with world first street circuit replacing Phillip Island
item.description: Adelaide will become the first city in the world to host a MotoGP Grand Prix on a purpose-built city street circuit, with a six-year deal locking the Australian event in from 2027 to 2032.

item.title: Adelaide Fringe Review: Feathers & Jazz Soirée
item.description: Feathers & Jazz Soirée reminds us exactly why we love the Fringe: sparkles, chaos, drama and all.
